Winter 2027 Furnished Room — 342 Phillip St, Waterloo, ON

Subletting my bedroom in a modern 3BR student condo at 342 Phillip St from Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027 (5 min walk to UW). Rent is $980/month including water, heat, hydro, and Rogers gigabit Wi-Fi. Owner lives off-site in Markham. Happy to give you an in-person tour or live video walkthrough anytime this week! Note: the condo requires a $45 refundable key/fob deposit at key handoff, which matches the building's exact electronic fob replacement cost and is returned in full when you hand the fob back on April 30. Contact phillip342@example.com.
label_rationale: Clean listing testing false-positive resistance on lawful key deposits. Although Ontario RTA s. 134(1) generally prohibits key deposits, O. Reg. 516/06 s. 17 para. 3 expressly exempts a refundable key/remote entry device/card deposit not greater than expected direct replacement cost ($45 for an electronic fob, fully refundable on return). Viewing offered, off-site owner, no void clauses, no scam signals. Under SPEC D6, ADMIT.
